description: This Java class defines event handlers for product search operations in the OFBiz framework, including adding/removing features, categorizing products, exporting search results, and managing search constraints.

classes.name: ProductSearchEvents
classes.description: Contains static methods for handling product search related events such as adding/removing features, categorizing products, and exporting search results.

methods.name: searchRemoveFromCategory
methods.description: Removes search results from a specified category.

methods.name: searchExpireFromCategory
methods.description: Sets the 'thru' date for search results in a category to expire them.

methods.name: searchAddToCategory
methods.description: Adds search results to a specified category with a 'from' date.

methods.name: searchAddFeature
methods.description: Adds a feature to search results.

methods.name: searchRemoveFeature
methods.description: Removes a feature from search results.

methods.name: searchExportProductList
methods.description: Exports search results as a tab-delimited list.

methods.name: getProductSearchResults
methods.description: Retrieves the current product search results based on session constraints.
